name: Copilot Setup

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: stable

      - name: Resolve workspace dependencies
        run: dart pub get
